Preface This online book serves as a compilation of of handouts, websites and tutorials that I have used in my data reporting class at ASU’s Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication. Some of the material will be useful in other courses or for self-study, but it is primarily aimed at the investigative journalism masters’ students at Cronkite. It covers: - Reporting and replication in data journalism - Table stakes: Spreadsheets in the newsroom - Analyzing data for stories using R and R Markdown It doesn’t cover: - Data visualization for publication - Working with non-tabular data such as images, sound or document collections - Creating news applications - Freedom of Information and public records techniques - Data science. This is a journalism book, not a programming or statistics book. A note on language: I’ll use the words “read” and “write” in a generic sense. I intend them to cover the range of journalistic media, including listening, watching, and news applications or graphics. Credits I’m grateful to all of the trainers, experts and collaborators who have made their training materials open to the world, and they are linked prominently throughout this book. Any errors or omissions are my own. This book was written in bookdown using RStudio . The complete source is available on Github. It was built using R version 4.1.2, bookdown version 0.24 using the bs4_book template (slightly tweaked by me, and style informed by Stat 545 by Jenny Bryan) – Sarah Cohen, Winter 2021-22 sarah.h.cohen@asu.edu === README.md (md) === Here is the website for the current textbook used in ASU Cronkite School's data journalism class for investigative reporting masters' students: https://cronkitedata.github.io/djtextbook === _bookdown.yml (yml) === before_chapter_script: _common.R delete_merged_file: true new_session: true keep_md: false language: ui: chapter_name: " " output_dir: docs book_filename: reporting_book rmd_files: - index.Rmd - start.Rmd - start-story.Rmd - start-math.Rmd - start-data-def.Rmd - start-data-diary.Rmd - start-hunt.Rmd - start-build-own.Rmd - xl.Rmd - xl-refresher.Rmd - xl-filter-sort.Rmd - xl-pivot.Rmd - xl-formulas.Rmd - xl-practice-noc.Rmd - r.Rmd - r-start.Rmd - r-markdown.Rmd - r-data-import.Rmd - r-verbs.Rmd - r-verb-filter.Rmd - r-verb-groupby.Rmd - r-verb-mutate.Rmd - r-verb-join.Rmd - r-recipes.Rmd - viz.Rmd - viz-reporting.Rmd - viz-demo.Rmd - advanced.Rmd - advanced-regex.Rmd - advanced-openrefine.Rmd - advanced-scrape1.Rmd - advanced-scrape2.Rmd - appendix-math.Rmd - appendix-program.Rmd - appendix-glossary.Rmd - appendix-resources.Rmd - appendix-ppp.Rmd === _common.R (r) === # example R options set globally # options(width = 60) # example chunk options set globally #knitr::opts_chunk$set( # comment = "#>", # collapse = TRUE # ) === _output.yml (yml) === bookdown::bs4_book: css: - style.css theme: bootswatch: flatly primary: "#096B72" base_font: google: "Muli" includes: in_header: head.html df_print: kable config: toc: before:
